article.story: Florida State (4-5) at Pittsburgh (6-3), Nov. 13 at 7 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Pittsburgh by 3.5. Against the spread: Pittsburgh 5-4, Florida State 4-4-1. How to watch: ESPN Key stats Pittsburgh Offense Overall: 446.1 yards per game (24th in FBS) Passing: 278.4 yards per game (18th) Rushing: 167.7 yards per game (52nd) Scoring: 31.9 points per game (45th) Pittsburgh Defense Overall: 320.7 yards per game (29th in FBS) Passing: 252.6 yards per game (123rd) Rushing: 68.1 yards per game (2nd) Scoring: 19.8 points per game (31st) Florida State Offense Overall: 410.6 yards per game (46th in FBS) Passing: 240.8 yards per game (50th) Rushing: 169.8 yards per game (49th) Scoring: 30.7 points per game (51st) Florida State Defense Overall: 412.8 yards per game (122nd in FBS) Passing: 239.4 yards per game (110th) Rushing: 173.3 yards per game (104th) Scoring: 28.3 points per game (101st) Florida State ranks 127th in the FBS with a -7 turnover margin, compared to Pittsburgh's 50th-ranked +2 margin. Pittsburgh is 134th in the FBS averaging 80.1 penalty yards per game, compared to Florida State's 73rd-ranked 55.8 per-game average. Pittsburgh is 14th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 74.1% of red zone trips. Florida State is 113th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:16, compared to Pittsburgh's 40th-ranked average of 31:14. Team leaders Pittsburgh Passing: Mason Heintschel, 1,304 yards, 14 TDs, 1 INT, 66.2 completion percentage Rushing: Damon Ferguson Jr., 662 yards on 123 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Cataurus Hicks, 698 yards on 34 catches, 6 TDs Florida State Passing: Ashton Daniels, 2,146 yards, 14 TDs, 12 INTs, 59.2 completion percentage Rushing: Ousmane Kromah, 609 yards on 114 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Micahi Danzy, 487 yards on 30 catches, 3 TDs Last game Pittsburgh defeated Georgia Tech 34-11 on Oct. 31. Holden Geriner led Pittsburgh with 180 yards on 13-of-30 passing (43.3%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Ferguson carried the ball 31 times for 185 yards and scored two touchdowns, adding one reception for 11 yards. Censere Lee had three receptions for 56 yards. Florida State won 31-24 over Boston College on Nov. 7. Daniels led Florida State with 178 yards on 15-of-26 passing (57.7%) for no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 10 times for 38 yards and one rushing touchdown. Amari Thomas had 98 rushing yards on 19 carries and two touchdowns, adding one reception for nine yards. Danzy had seven receptions for 86 yards. Next game Pittsburgh plays at Louisville on Nov. 21. Florida State hosts NC State on Nov. 21.
